title: Electric Power Resiliency Building 56
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY > DLA DISTRIBUTION > DLA DISTRIBUTION
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with part 12 to accomplish  at theDefense Distribution San Joaquin California.Contractor is to provide all labor, supervision, materials, tools, and equipment to design and modify the existing electrical system to include 500 KW AC roof mounted solar photovoltaicsystem for building 56. but not limited to:The solar photovoltaic (PV) system hardware and services shall meet or exceed all local, State and utility requirements, conform to the applicable codes and standards, and have passed thelisting and qualification tests. All design and installation shall comply with the most recent version of each document.The final design of the on-site PV systems shall be the responsibility of the Contractor based on site conditions, roofing materials, and final system component selections by the Contractor.The systems must be compliant with applicable design guidelines. This Section identifies the minimum technical and installation specifications required. The PV systems shall be consistentwith and adhere to all California Building Codes and standards, the California Solar Initiative program, and any and all CEC technical and installation specifications and guidelines.There is one existing electric substation feeding building 56 with a capacity: 12470/408V, 3000KVA transformer. Switchgear is rated: 4000A bus bar and four existing 1200A frame sizecircuit breaker spaces are available.
